## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:` ...)
- [ ] A changeset is added (`pnpm changeset`) if the published package changes, or this PR has the `no-changeset` label
- [ ] Tests are added or updated
- [ ] Docs are updated (README, CONTRIBUTING, examples) where relevant
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test` pass locally
